candidates.statement: Gateway checkout POSTs return 502 because the downstream order service returns 500 on POST /v1/orders; traces and logs show the gateway's client call to order failing with 500, propagating as 502 to /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side cause of the 500 (db pool, redis, payment latency) is not established; only gateway-side evidence is available.

report.explanation: Gateway evidence consistently shows /v1/checkout 502s caused by downstream order service 500s on POST /v1/orders, with fast failures (~15-60ms) and healthy /readyz. The bounded candidate is an order-service HTTP 500 propagating to the gateway; the specific order-side fault is not yet established.
